note: Opens with the classical side recorded for Smithsonian Folkways in 1991: instrumental phobin and lagu dalem medleys by Gambang Kromong Irama Bersatu, three of them sung by Masnah (Pang Tjin Nio), then lagu sayur by Slendang Betawi. Benyamin S. and Ida Royani stand for the Betawi pop of the 1970s (their tracks come from 2002-04 compilations, so no year); the rest are neighbourhood orchestras on 1990s DPM-MTR cassettes, Citra Suara's 2010 album, a 2019 live single and Tukang Tabuh's instrumental EPs of 2022-24.

size.basis: A judgement, not a count. Made before collecting, from what is known of the catalogue: 78s of Chinese-Peranakan orchestras from the 1920s-30s (few survive in archives), a long run of Betawi pop records of the late 1960s-70s where gambang kromong backs singers such as Benyamin S and Ida Royani, Indonesian cassettes of lenong, cokek and lagu sayur by many neighbourhood orchestras (Indonesian Wikipedia lists over thirty classical groups), one international field-recording album (Smithsonian Folkways' Music of Indonesia vol. 3, 1991) and a small flow of recent digital releases. An insider's essential list would be about 30 recordings: the Folkways album, the classical phobin and lagu dalem of the Peranakan orchestras and singers such as Pang Tjin Nio, and the best-known Benyamin S gambang kromong songs.
